sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:157

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:157:1
items.html: The tenth of the Nukva of ZA alone, and this is the secret of “the lower Ima nests in Ofan”: The matter of this division of the Mochin of Ima, which the ARI explains here only in the Nukva of Beria, Yetzira and Assiya — the intention is not that this order applies only in the Nukva, for so it is in all the Partzufim from Ima and below, as the ARI writes below, and likewise above (page 1972, item 151); rather, he wishes to explain in this discourse only the two Partzufim, ZA and the Nukva of BYA, in all their particulars; therefore he speaks here only of the Partzuf of the Nukva of BYA alone.
